direct_provider_comparison.expected_limiter: Tiny N1: host validation and launch; forward observed device execution dominates. No kernel promotion claim.
direct_provider_comparison.workload: 35 destination rows x 67 source columns, 52 signed edges, asymmetric unsorted support, every fourth row empty, N=1
direct_provider_comparison.baseline: core::run_prepared_operation with the identical prepared forward/transpose operation, projection buffers, resident packed values, dense pointers, numeric tuple, stream, output overwrite and launch records used by ce::enqueue

numerics.oracle: double on exactly stored f16 values

timing_boundaries.cold: One preparation after CUDA context initialization; includes host geometry, both physical projections, allocation, three host-to-device uploads, stream synchronization and provider preparation. Excludes context startup and caller input/weight allocation.
timing_boundaries.refresh: Resident logical f16 to resident packed f16 device gather; host submission, event span and stream-complete elapsed measured separately across 32 new generations. Excludes prior caller H2D copy.
timing_boundaries.host: steady_clock around repeated calls only; excludes event recording and final synchronization
timing_boundaries.event: CUDA events bracket batch on same nonblocking caller stream; includes device work and gaps waiting for host submission
timing_boundaries.resident: steady_clock from begin-event submission through end-event synchronization; includes host work and explicit completion; per-launch amortized
timing_boundaries.copies: All caller H2D inputs/weights and D2H oracle readbacks are outside repeated timings. Preparation uploads are inside cold timing. No repeated path copies.
timing_boundaries.synchronization: One stream drain before each batch, one event synchronization at batch end; no per-launch or device-wide synchronization. Event creation/destruction outside timings.

direct_provider_comparison.correctness: Both direct and adapter checked independently against a logical-edge double oracle on exactly stored f16 values before and after timed batches; finite check and 1e-5+1e-5*abs(expected) tolerance.
direct_provider_comparison.diagnosis: Adapter adds roughly 0.6 us host work for biological semantic/axis/generation checks, cudaGetDevice and pointer residency checks, and constructing launch records. Source audit confirms constant-size checks, one unchanged provider dispatch, no topology hashing/search, allocation, copy or synchronization. Forward resident medians equal (~16.51 us); transpose medians 2.68 vs 2.82 us, a small absolute difference. Retain required validation; no broad speedup or kernel-regression claim. These tiny observations do not establish general workload performance.

fix_log.problem: Valid structure identity derived an all-zero transpose projection ID, rejected by existing provider.
fix_log.observed_error: transpose requirements need distinct valid projection identities
fix_log.fix: Repair reserved zero transpose projection ID with low=1; remains distinct from nonzero forward.high. No change to ordinary identities or kernels.
fix_log.regression: Public publish_values/enqueue in both orientations and generations for both zero-forward and zero-transpose derivations; validates nonzero distinct projections.

fix_log.problem: N06 had no measured matched direct-provider comparison.
fix_log.fix: Added bounded overhead_test using exact same prepared provider objects and bindings, independent correctness and explicit timing boundaries.
